cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
The objective of this issue tracker is to gather users which are affected by the issue
---

**App involved**: [Raycast (Floating Notes)](https://www.raycast.com/)

[**Forum post related**](https://forums.ankiweb.net/t/copy-paste-issue/37168?u=namelessgo)

**Workaround**: Because Anki relies on clipboard change events, it seems that switching to another application, fixes the issue

Example of workaround: Copy "A"in anki, then "B" in floating note (Raycast), then switch application and paste on Anki, it would fix the issue and paste the correct "B" instead of "AB"


Steps to reproduce:
1. Copy text (a) from field in Anki.
2. Copy another text (b) from another app.
3. Paste text in Anki (this renders text a)
4. Paste text in Anki again (this renders text b).

![65f01f5eb813305c774d36083971285a73065a89](https://github.com/ankitects/anki/assets/66227691/f616c3cd-9639-445a-b5df-e0d3da02fde5)
Credits for reporting, providing the steps to reproduce and GIF: herrsilen

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix macOS clipboard issues

Fixes #2843.

Also fixes [this issue](https://forums.ankiweb.net/t/copy-paste-of-screenshots-dont-work-once-i-copy-the-text-on-the-anki-app/34839), which actually wasn't properly fixed.

The issue is that `QClipboard.dataChanged` doesn't always properly fire on macOS when performing copy operations outiside of the app. I fixed this by adding just-in-time checking if the clipboard changed before pasting.

The ideal solution would be getting Qt to work properly, but until then this solution should be 100% working.

         gui_hooks.editor_web_view_did_init(self)
 
     def user_cut_or_copied(self) -> None:
@@ -1412,6 +1413,7 @@ class EditorWebView(AnkiWebView):
         self._internal_field_text_for_paste = None
 
     def _on_clipboard_change(self) -> None:
+        self._last_known_clipboard_mime = self.editor.mw.app.clipboard().mimeData()
         if self._store_field_content_on_next_clipboard_change:
             # if the flag was set, save the field data

     def _onPaste(self, mode: QClipboard.Mode) -> None:

+            self._on_clipboard_change()
